name: AcneStar Gel 22g Clindamycin & Nicotinamide Gel | Made in INDIA
description:
Reduces Acne and Pimples: Targets the root cause of acne, minimizing breakouts and preventing future occurrences. 
Minimizes Inflammation: Calms redness and swelling, promoting faster healing. 
Regulates Oil Production: Controls excess sebum, preventing clogged pores and oily skin. 
Soothes and Hydrates: Provides relief from dryness and irritation, leaving skin soft and supple. 
Improves Skin Texture: Refines pores and evens skin tone for a smoother, more radiant complexion.
